subject: AWS co-sell: seller handshake, mutual action plan & demo booking
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Li <sophie.li@medflow.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-10T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: AWS co-sell: seller handshake, mutual action plan & demo booking

Hi Sophie —

Great to meet briefly on the phone earlier. Redwood would love to get MedFlow into the AWS partner/co-sell motion; to move quickly I’ve attached a lightweight mutual action plan (MA_plan_template.xlsx) and a draft SOW for scope alignment (SOW-draft-v1.pdf).

Suggested next steps / agenda for a 30–45m kickoff:
- Quick intros + success criteria (5m)
- Short product demo focused on EMR ingestion + privacy controls (15m)
- Mutual action plan review and owners (10m)
- Procurement / security gating and timeline (10m)

Available windows next week (PST):
- Tue 6/15 10:00–10:45am
- Wed 6/16 1:30–2:15pm
- Thu 6/17 9:00–9:45am

Can you confirm who from MedFlow should join (technical + procurement)? I’ll bring Karthik (AM) and Kimberly (Marketplace/Co-sell ops).

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0124

Attachments: MA_plan_template.xlsx, SOW-draft-v1.pdf
From: Sophie Li <sophie.li@medflow.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@medflow.io>
Date: 2027-06-10T19:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell: seller handshake, mutual action plan & demo booking

Marissa —

Thanks for the note and the materials. MedFlow is very interested in exploring an AWS co-sell path; copying Raj (CTO) who will lead the technical review. For procurement/security, please loop in Emily Cho (I’ll add her separately) — she owns vendor contracts and budget approvals.

Quick asks on our side before the kickoff:
- Can you share a brief SOC 2 summary or an attestation? We’ll need that for our procurement team.
- We’ve got an internal vendor questionnaire — I attached the MedFlow template (Medflow_vendor_questionnaire.xlsx). Can you confirm who on your side should own responses and approximate turnaround?

Proposed attendees: Sophie Li (Dir, Product), Raj Patel (CTO), Emily Cho (Procurement), Marissa, Karthik, Kimberly.

Of your proposed slots, Wed 6/16 1:30–2:15pm PST works best for us. Please send a calendar invite and any read-ahead.

Thanks — looking forward.

Subject: Re: AWS co-sell: seller handshake, mutual action plan & demo booking

Hi Sophie, Raj —

Thanks for the quick reply and the questionnaire. I’m Kimberly (Marketplace & Co-sell Ops) — I’ll help run the MA plan and the AWS marketplace readiness checklist. A couple of operational notes to make the kickoff productive:

Pre-demo checklist (short):
- Confirm desired demo scenario (PII handling + EMR ingest) — Marissa noted this, we’ll tailor slides to MedFlow examples.
- Upload or share redacted sample data schema (if you can) — helps our demo run fast.
- Security artifacts we can provide quickly: SOC2 Type II summary, data retention policy, basic encryption-at-rest notes (I’ve attached a filled example view: MA_plan_filled_example.xlsx).

AWS co-sell runbook & partner resources: https://aws.amazon.com/partner-network/ (link for your ops folks). I’ll also coordinate with the AWS partner rep on including a seller rep in the kickoff so we can open the co-sell intake.

Wed 6/16 1:30–2:15pm PST is confirmed for Redwood side. Marissa — can you send the calendar invite to the attendees Sophie listed and include a short read-ahead: one-pager + sample MA plan?

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Marketplace & Co-sell Operations
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: MA_plan_filled_example.xlsx

All — thanks for confirming. I’ll own the MA plan on the Redwood side (RACI: Karthik — Redwood owner, Sophie — MedFlow product owner, Raj — MedFlow technical lead, Emily — MedFlow procurement).

I’ve booked the 30m kickoff: Wed 2027-06-16 13:30–14:00 PST (calendar invite sent). Read-ahead attached: one-pager + MA plan template + vendor questionnaire we requested earlier. Action items before the meeting:
- MedFlow: share any redacted sample schema + procurement constraints (Emily) — due Tue 6/15 EOD.
- Redwood: provide SOC2 summary and sample runbook (Kimberly) — due Tue 6/15 EOD.
- Both: confirm demo user story by Tue 6/15.

Link to contract/DSA for initial review: https://app.docusign.com/transaction/12345-abcdef

Short and sweet — see you all on Wed.
